content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **JSON Serialization** as part of **Serialization, Networking, and Application Integration**. Serialization converts values to a defined external format; Kotlin serialization needs its plugin and format library, and untrusted input still requires validation. Use the subtopics—Serializable Data Models, Encoding and Decoding JSON, Handling Missing, Unknown, and Invalid Fields—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: Professional applications need repeatable tests, clear APIs, dependable dependencies, security checks, and observable failures. Apply this concept in small steps before integrating it into a larger project.

content_blocks.text: Parsing external JSON makes its values trustworthy without validation.
